text: 90+2分、シーブルック・タウンのキアン・ロマーノが相手のパスをカットしてボールを奪うと、アイデン・クインランのスルーパスを受けてゴール！6.8メートルの距離から決めたシュートは、約6割の確率で決まるチャンスでした。これでスコアは2-2の同点から3-2とシーブルック・タウンがリードを奪いました[#1879][#1882]。

trace.output: Brief: GOAL - Kian Romano (Seabrook Town) for fan audience in ja

- Kian Romano scored a goal from 6.8 meters on a counter situation, assisted by Aiden Quinlan's through pass [#1882].  
- The goal changed the score from 2-2 to 3-2 in favor of Seabrook Town at 90+2' [#1882].  
- The goal resulted from a high turnover interception by Kian Romano, quickly leading to a 2-pass build-up and final shot [#1879, #1880, #1881, #1882].  
- Seabrook Town dominated the last 10 minutes with 55.5% possession, 3 shots (1 on target), and one big chance [last_10_minutes].  
- Harbour City had no shots or big chances in the last 10 minutes and only 44.5% possession [last_10_minutes].

- Seabrook Town won the ball via a high turnover interception by Kian Romano near their own 77th meter line, starting a quick counter-attack [#1879].
- The counter consisted of only 2 passes over 6.7 seconds, demonstrating a rapid transition from defense to attack, capitalizing on Harbour City's higher line and possible positioning vulnerabilities [#1879, #1880, #1881].
- The assist was a through pass by Aiden Quinlan into space for Romano, who finished from close range (6.8 meters), showing effective use of forward runs against Harbour City's 4-2-3-1 patient passing setup that likely left them exposed on the break [#1881, #1882].
- Seabrook Town, playing in a 3-4-3 formation favoring wide, crossing play, adapted by exploiting the counter situation rather than their usual crossing pattern to break the 2-2 deadlock and take the lead late in the game [team_styles, #1882].
- The pressing trap or overload pattern is not evident here; instead, the tactical success was based on forcing a high turnover and swift exploitation of space on the counter against a more possession-oriented opponent [#1879, #1880].
